49n 0.9 49.2n 0 \

86n 0.9 \
]

0 0.45 \
18n 0.42 \
23n 0.74 \
35n 0.74 \
36n 0.18 \
50n 0.18 \
54n 0.58 \
68n 0.58 \
72n 0.84 \
84n 0.84 \
86n 0.45 \

XDUT (clk rst gain_sel vin out metric) programmable_gain_amplifier

tran tran stop=86n maxstep=2p strobeperiod=2p
save clk rst gain_sel vin out metric
